@dataclass(frozen=True)

    tournament_id: Optional[int]
    events: int
    with_payload: int
    finished: int
    seasons: int
    by_status: Mapping[str, int]
    first_start_ts: Optional[int]
    last_start_ts: Optional[int]
    updated_at: Optional[int]
